#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build the enhanced BLS labor-productivity workbook.

Loads the pristine input workbook, inserts two new worksheets (Summary, Analysis)
with live formulas linked to the original Annual sheet, a scenario dropdown with
editable assumption cells and a formula-driven projection, a bar chart over
formula-linked values, plus formatting, freeze panes, conditional formatting,
and source/assumption comments. Saves output/industry_productivity_enhanced.xlsx
and output/workbook_features.json.

Skill color conventions applied to new content only:
  blue  (FF0000FF) = editable inputs (selector + assumption cells)
  green (FF008000) = formulas pulling from other worksheets (Annual)
  black (FF000000) = local formulas / labels
"""
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/vendor/wheels/openpyxl-3.1.5-py2.py3-none-any.whl')
from openpyxl import load_workbook
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, Reference
from openpyxl.chart.label import DataLabelList
from openpyxl.comments import Comment
from openpyxl.formatting.rule import ColorScaleRule, DataBarRule, FormulaRule
from openpyxl.styles import Alignment, Font, PatternFill
from openpyxl.worksheet.datavalidation import DataValidation

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
INPUT = ROOT / 'input/labor-productivity-detailed-industries.xlsx'
TARGET = '/root/.openclaw/workspace/tool-modeling/OFFICE-XLSX-INDUSTRY-PRODUCTIVITY/output/industry_productivity_enhanced.xlsx'
OUTPUT = Path(TARGET)
FEATURES = ROOT / 'output/workbook_features.json'

BLUE = 'FF0000FF'
GREEN = 'FF008000'
BLACK = 'FF000000'

TITLE_FILL = PatternFill('solid', start_color='1F4E79')
SECTION_FILL = PatternFill('solid', start_color='D9E2F3')
NOTE_FILL = PatternFill('solid', start_color='FFF2CC')
HEADER_FONT = Font(name='Arial', size=11, bold=True, color='FFFFFFFF')
TITLE_FONT = Font(name='Arial', size=14, bold=True, color='FFFFFFFF')
SECTION_FONT = Font(name='Arial', size=11, bold=True, color='FF1F4E79')
NOTE_FONT = Font(name='Arial', size=9, italic=True, color='FF404040')
WRAP = Alignment(wrap_text=True, vertical='top')
LEFT = Alignment(horizontal='left', vertical='center')
RIGHT = Alignment(horizontal='right', vertical='center')


def font(color=BLACK, bold=False, italic=False, size=11):
    return Font(name='Arial', size=size, bold=bold, italic=italic, color=color)


def build_summary(wb):
    ws = wb.create_sheet('Summary', 0)
    widths = {'A': 52, 'B': 30, 'C': 18, 'D': 34, 'E': 12}
    for col, w in widths.items():
        ws.column_dimensions[col].width = w

    # Title block
    ws.merge_cells('A1:E1')
    ws['A1'] = 'Labor Productivity in Food Manufacturing - BLS Detailed Industries Analysis'
    ws['A1'].font = TITLE_FONT
    ws['A1'].fill = TITLE_FILL
    ws['A1'].alignment = Alignment(horizontal='left', vertical='center')
    ws.row_dimensions[1].height = 24
    ws.merge_cells('A2:E2')
    ws['A2'] = ('Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Office of Productivity and Technology, '
                'labor-productivity-detailed-industries.xlsx, Annual tab (released September 24, 2026).')
    ws['A2'].font = font(italic=True, size=10)
    ws['A2'].alignment = WRAP
    ws.row_dimensions[2].height = 28
    ws.merge_cells('A3:E3')
    ws['A3'] = ('The MachineReadable tab holds the same published series in long form; '
                'all calculations below use the Annual tab only. Suppression markers (N.A.) are retained.')
    ws['A3'].font = font(italic=True, size=10)
    ws['A3'].alignment = WRAP
    ws.row_dimensions[3].height = 28

    # Section 1: published metrics
    ws.merge_cells('A5:E5')
    ws['A5'] = 'PUBLISHED METRICS - NAICS 311 Food Manufacturing, All workers'
    ws['A5'].font = SECTION_FONT
    ws['A5'].fill = SECTION_FILL
    ws['A5'].alignment = Alignment(horizontal='left', vertical='center')
    for col, text in (('A6', 'Metric'), ('B6', 'Unit'), ('C6', 'Value')):
        ws[col].font = HEADER_FONT
        ws[col].fill = TITLE_FILL
        ws[col].alignment = LEFT

    ws['A7'] = 'Labor productivity index, 2025'
    ws['A7'].font = font()
    ws['A7'].alignment = LEFT
    ws['B7'] = 'index (2017=100)'
    ws['B7'].font = font()
    ws['B7'].alignment = LEFT
    ws['C7'] = '=Annual!AT487'
    ws['C7'].font = font(color=GREEN)
    ws['C7'].number_format = '0.000'
    ws['C7'].alignment = RIGHT
    ws['C7'].comment = Comment(
        'Source: Annual tab, NAICS 311 Food manufacturing, All workers, Labor productivity, '
        'Units "Index (2017=100)", year 2025 (cell Annual!AT487). '
        'Published level; MachineReadable tab carries the same series in long form.',
        'Productivity Analysis')

    ws['A8'] = 'Year-over-year change, 2024 to 2025'
    ws['A8'].font = font()
    ws['A8'].alignment = LEFT
    ws['B8'] = 'fraction'
    ws['B8'].font = font()
    ws['B8'].alignment = LEFT
    ws['C8'] = '=(Annual!AT487-Annual!AS487)/Annual!AS487'
    ws['C8'].font = font(color=GREEN)
    ws['C8'].number_format = '0.0000'
    ws['C8'].alignment = RIGHT
    ws['C8'].comment = Comment(
        'Formula: (2025 index - 2024 index) / 2024 index using published Annual tab levels '
        '(Annual!AT487 and Annual!AS487). Not seasonally adjusted; published levels as reported.',
        'Productivity Analysis')

    ws['A9'] = 'Change since 2020, 2020 to 2025'
    ws['A9'].font = font()
    ws['A9'].alignment = LEFT
    ws['B9'] = 'fraction'
    ws['B9'].font = font()
    ws['B9'].alignment = LEFT
    ws['C9'] = '=(Annual!AT487-Annual!AO487)/Annual!AO487'
    ws['C9'].font = font(color=GREEN)
    ws['C9'].number_format = '0.0000'
    ws['C9'].alignment = RIGHT
    ws['C9'].comment = Comment(
        'Formula: (2025 index - 2020 index) / 2020 index using published Annual tab levels '
        '(Annual!AT487 and Annual!AO487).',
        'Productivity Analysis')

    # Section 2: illustrative scenario
    ws.merge_cells('A11:E11')
    ws['A11'] = 'ILLUSTRATIVE SCENARIO - assumption-driven projection (not a forecast)'
    ws['A11'].font = SECTION_FONT
    ws['A11'].fill = SECTION_FILL
    ws['A11'].alignment = Alignment(horizontal='left', vertical='center')

    ws['A12'] = 'Scenario selector (dropdown):'
    ws['A12'].font = font(bold=True)
    ws['A12'].alignment = LEFT
    ws['C12'] = 'Base'
    ws['C12'].font = font(color=BLUE, bold=True)
    ws['C12'].alignment = LEFT
    ws['D12'] = 'Select Base, Higher, or Lower from the dropdown.'
    ws['D12'].font = NOTE_FONT
    ws['D12'].alignment = WRAP
    ws['C12'].comment = Comment(
        'Editable input (blue). Illustrative scenario selector; the chosen multiplier is applied '
        'to the published 2025 index to form the projection. Not a forecast - assumptions are user-editable.',
        'Productivity Analysis')
    dv = DataValidation(type='list', formula1='"Base,Higher,Lower"', allow_blank=False,
                        showErrorMessage=True)
    dv.error = 'Choose Base, Higher, or Lower.'
    dv.errorTitle = 'Invalid scenario'
    ws.add_data_validation(dv)
    dv.add('C12')

    for col, text in (('A13', 'Scenario'), ('B13', 'Productivity multiplier (illustrative)')):
        ws[col].font = HEADER_FONT
        ws[col].fill = TITLE_FILL
        ws[col].alignment = LEFT

    assumptions = [('Base', 1.0, 'B14', 14), ('Higher', 1.05, 'B15', 15), ('Lower', 0.95, 'B16', 16)]
    for name, value, cell, row in assumptions:
        ws[f'A{row}'] = name
        ws[f'A{row}'].font = font()
        ws[f'A{row}'].alignment = LEFT
        ws[cell] = value
        ws[cell].font = font(color=BLUE)
        ws[cell].number_format = '0.00'
        ws[cell].alignment = RIGHT

    ws['A18'] = 'Projected productivity index (2025 index x selected multiplier)'
    ws['A18'].font = font(bold=True)
    ws['A18'].alignment = LEFT
    ws['B18'] = 'index (2017=100)'
    ws['B18'].font = font()
    ws['B18'].alignment = LEFT
    ws['C18'] = '=C7*INDEX(B14:B16,MATCH(C12,A14:A16,0))'
    ws['C18'].font = font(color=BLACK, bold=True)
    ws['C18'].number_format = '0.000'
    ws['C18'].alignment = RIGHT
    ws['C18'].comment = Comment(
        'Local formula (black): published 2025 index (Summary!C7, linked to Annual!AT487) multiplied by '
        'the selected scenario multiplier via INDEX/MATCH over the assumptions table (B14:B16 / A14:A16).',
        'Productivity Analysis')

    ws.merge_cells('A20:E20')
    ws['A20'] = ('Note: NAICS 316 (Leather and allied products) 2025 productivity is suppressed '
                 '("N.A.") in the source and is excluded from the industry comparison chart.')
    ws['A20'].font = NOTE_FONT
    ws['A20'].fill = NOTE_FILL
    ws['A20'].alignment = WRAP
    ws.row_dimensions[20].height = 28
    ws.merge_cells('A21:E21')
    ws['A21'] = ('All change metrics are computed from published annual index levels; '
                 'no missing observations are inferred or combined across industries or representations.')
    ws['A21'].font = NOTE_FONT
    ws['A21'].fill = NOTE_FILL
    ws['A21'].alignment = WRAP
    ws.row_dimensions[21].height = 28

    # Conditional formatting on Summary
    ws.conditional_formatting.add('C7:C9', ColorScaleRule(
        start_type='min', start_color='F8696B',
        mid_type='percentile', mid_value=50, mid_color='FFEB84',
        end_type='max', end_color='63BE7B'))
    ws.conditional_formatting.add('A14:C16', FormulaRule(
        formula=['$C$12=$A14'], fill=PatternFill('solid', start_color='FFF2CC'), stopIfTrue=False))

    ws.freeze_panes = 'A5'
    return ws


def build_analysis(wb):
    ws = wb.create_sheet('Analysis', 1)
    widths = {'A': 36, 'B': 12, 'C': 20, 'D': 8, 'E': 12, 'F': 12, 'G': 12, 'H': 12}
    for col, w in widths.items():
        ws.column_dimensions[col].width = w

    ws.merge_cells('A1:H1')
    ws['A1'] = '2025 Labor Productivity Index by 3-Digit Manufacturing Industry'
    ws['A1'].font = TITLE_FONT
    ws['A1'].fill = TITLE_FILL
    ws['A1'].alignment = Alignment(horizontal='left', vertical='center')
    ws.row_dimensions[1].height = 24
    ws.merge_cells('A2:H2')
    ws['A2'] = ('Source: Annual tab (All workers, Labor productivity, Index (2017=100)); published levels '
                'as reported. NAICS 316 is suppressed ("N.A.") in 2025 and is not shown.')
    ws['A2'].font = font(italic=True, size=10)
    ws['A2'].alignment = WRAP
    ws.row_dimensions[2].height = 28

    headers = (('A4', 'Industry'), ('B4', 'NAICS'), ('C4', '2025 Index (2017=100)'))
    for col, text in headers:
        ws[col].font = HEADER_FONT
        ws[col].fill = TITLE_FILL
        ws[col].alignment = LEFT

    rows = [
        ('Food manufacturing', 311, 'AT487', 5),
        ('Beverages and tobacco products', 312, 'AT510', 6),
        ('Textile mills', 313, 'AT533', 7),
        ('Textile product mills', 314, 'AT556', 8),
        ('Apparel', 315, 'AT579', 9),
    ]
    for name, naics, cell, row in rows:
        ws[f'A{row}'] = name
        ws[f'A{row}'].font = font()
        ws[f'A{row}'].alignment = LEFT
        ws[f'B{row}'] = naics
        ws[f'B{row}'].font = font()
        ws[f'B{row}'].alignment = LEFT
        ws[f'C{row}'] = f'=Annual!{cell}'
        ws[f'C{row}'].font = font(color=GREEN)
        ws[f'C{row}'].number_format = '0.000'
        ws[f'C{row}'].alignment = RIGHT
    ws['C5'].comment = Comment(
        'Formula-linked value: Annual tab, NAICS 311 Food manufacturing, All workers, '
        'Labor productivity, Index (2017=100), year 2025 (Annual!AT487).',
        'Productivity Analysis')

    ws.merge_cells('A11:H11')
    ws['A11'] = ('Published levels are compared as reported. Levels are not combined across industries '
                 'or between the Annual and MachineReadable representations.')
    ws['A11'].font = NOTE_FONT
    ws['A11'].fill = NOTE_FILL
    ws['A11'].alignment = WRAP
    ws.row_dimensions[11].height = 28

    # Bar chart over formula-linked values
    chart = BarChart()
    chart.type = 'col'
    chart.style = 10
    chart.title = '2025 Labor Productivity Index (2017=100)'
    chart.y_axis.title = 'Index (2017=100)'
    chart.x_axis.title = 'Industry'
    chart.legend = None
    chart.width = 17
    chart.height = 9
    data = Reference(ws, min_col=3, min_row=5, max_row=9)
    cats = Reference(ws, min_col=1, min_row=5, max_row=9)
    chart.add_data(data, titles_from_data=False)
    chart.set_categories(cats)
    chart.dataLabels = DataLabelList()
    chart.dataLabels.showVal = True
    ws.add_chart(chart, 'E4')

    # Conditional formatting on Analysis
    ws.conditional_formatting.add('C5:C9', DataBarRule(
        start_type='min', end_type='max', color='638EC6', showValue=True))
    ws.conditional_formatting.add('C5:C9', ColorScaleRule(
        start_type='min', start_color='F8696B',
        mid_type='percentile', mid_value=50, mid_color='FFEB84',
        end_type='max', end_color='63BE7B'))
    return ws


def main():
    OUTPUT.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    print('loading input workbook...', flush=True)
    wb = load_workbook(INPUT, data_only=False)
    print('input sheets:', wb.sheetnames, flush=True)
    build_summary(wb)
    build_analysis(wb)
    print('output sheets:', wb.sheetnames, flush=True)
    wb.save(OUTPUT)
    wb.close()

    features = {
        'summary_sheet': 'Summary',
        'metrics': {
            'food_productivity_2025': {'sheet': 'Summary', 'cell': 'C7'},
            'food_productivity_yoy_change': {'sheet': 'Summary', 'cell': 'C8'},
            'food_productivity_change_since_2020': {'sheet': 'Summary', 'cell': 'C9'},
        },
        'scenario': {
            'selector': {'sheet': 'Summary', 'cell': 'C12'},
            'assumptions': {
                'Base': {'productivity_multiplier': {'sheet': 'Summary', 'cell': 'B14'}},
                'Higher': {'productivity_multiplier': {'sheet': 'Summary', 'cell': 'B15'}},
                'Lower': {'productivity_multiplier': {'sheet': 'Summary', 'cell': 'B16'}},
            },
            'projections': {
                'projected_productivity_index': {'sheet': 'Summary', 'cell': 'C18'},
            },
        },
        'charts': {
            'manufacturing_subindustry_2025': {'sheet': 'Analysis', 'index': 0},
        },
    }
    FEATURES.write_text(json.dumps(features, indent=2) + '\n')
    print('wrote', FEATURES, flush=True)
    print('saved', OUTPUT, flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
